BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff LIMIT 1) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff while immutable handoff evidence exists';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate();
DROP FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff();
DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff;

COMMIT;
